entry.description: Buy The Dip (4/5 conditions) - Wait for capitulation + derivatives reset

conditions.rationale: Short-term holders are underwater (cost basis > price)
Short-term holders actively selling at loss (capitulation)
Derivatives market bearish or neutral (no overheating)
Long liquidations exceed shorts (forced selling complete)

entry.timing_description: Enter on first day when threshold is met (4+ conditions true)

alternative_entry.description: More aggressive entry (3 of 5) generates more trades but lower win rate

exit.description: Momentum-confirmed valuation exit - Don't exit expensive markets until trend breaks

conditions.rationale: Market is overvalued relative to realized price
Price breaks below 50-day MA (trend reversal confirmed)

exit.timing_description: Exit on first day when BOTH conditions are true
exit.innovation: Combines valuation (MVRV) with momentum (MA) to avoid premature exits during sustained bull runs
